---
title: "Baby Name Trends"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
runtime: shiny
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

# Assume your dataframe is called 'df'
# If loading from file, uncomment and adjust:
load("data/clean_names_bystate.Rda")
```


Sidebar {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
textInput("name_input", "Name:", value = "Clara")

sliderInput("year_range", "Year Range:",
            min = min(df$year), 
            max = max(df$year),
            value = c(min(df$year), max(df$year)),
            step = 1,
            sep = "")

radioButtons("metric", "Display:",
             choices = c("Rates" = "rate", "Counts" = "count"),
             selected = "rate")

checkboxGroupInput("sex_select", "Sex:",
                   choices = c("Male" = "M", "Female" = "F", "Both (Combined)" = "Both"),
                   selected = "Both")

hr()

checkboxInput("select_all_check", "Select All States", value = TRUE)

actionButton("select_all", "Select All States")
actionButton("unselect_all", "Unselect All States")

checkboxGroupInput("states", "States:",
                   choices = sort(unique(df$state)),
                   selected = sort(unique(df$state)))

# Logic for select all checkbox
observeEvent(input$select_all_check, {
  if (input$select_all_check) {
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "states", 
                            selected = sort(unique(df$state)))
  }
})

# Logic for select/unselect all buttons
observeEvent(input$select_all, {
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "states", 
                          selected = sort(unique(df$state)))
  updateCheckboxInput(session, "select_all_check", value = TRUE)
})

observeEvent(input$unselect_all, {
  updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "states", 
                          selected = character(0))
  updateCheckboxInput(session, "select_all_check", value = FALSE)
})

# Uncheck "select all" if user manually deselects states
observeEvent(input$states, {
  if (length(input$states) < length(unique(df$state))) {
    updateCheckboxInput(session, "select_all_check", value = FALSE)
  }
})
```

Visualization {data-icon="fa-chart-line"}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Name Trends Over Time
```{r}
renderPlotly({
  # Filter by name, year, and state
  filtered_data <- df %>%
    filter(year >= input$year_range[1],
           year <= input$year_range[2],
           state %in% input$states,
           name == input$name_input)
  
  # Handle sex selection
  if ("Both" %in% input$sex_select) {
    # Sum M and F together
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      group_by(state, year, name) %>%
      summarize(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(sex = "Both")
  } else {
    # Filter for selected sexes
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      filter(sex %in% input$sex_select)
  }
  
  # Calculate rates
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(state, year) %>%
    mutate(rate = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Choose metric
  y_var <- input$metric
  y_label <- ifelse(y_var == "rate", 
                    "Rate (Fraction of All Births)", 
                    "Count")
  
  # Create ggplot
  p <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = year, y = .data[[y_var]], 
                            color = state, group = state,
                            text = paste0("State: ", state, 
                                        "<br>Year: ", year,
                                        "<br>Sex: ", sex,
                                        "<br>", y_label, ": ", 
                                        round(.data[[y_var]], 4)))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    labs(title = paste("Trends for", input$name_input),
         x = "Year",
         y = y_label,
         color = "State") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  # Convert to plotly for interactivity
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(hovermode = "closest")
})
```

Data Table {data-icon="fa-table"}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Summary Data
```{r}
renderDT({
  # Filter by name, year, and state
  table_data <- df %>%
    filter(year >= input$year_range[1],
           year <= input$year_range[2],
           state %in% input$states,
           name == input$name_input)
  
  # Handle sex selection
  if ("Both" %in% input$sex_select) {
    # Sum M and F together
    table_data <- table_data %>%
      group_by(state, year, name) %>%
      summarize(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(sex = "Both")
  } else {
    # Filter for selected sexes
    table_data <- table_data %>%
      filter(sex %in% input$sex_select)
  }
  
  # Calculate rates
  table_data <- table_data %>%
    group_by(state, year) %>%
    mutate(rate = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(state, year, sex, name, count, rate) %>%
    arrange(state, year)
  
  # Format rate as percentage
  table_data <- table_data %>%
    mutate(rate = paste0(round(rate * 100, 3), "%"))
  
  # Create interactive table
  datatable(table_data, 
            options = list(pageLength = 25,
                          scrollX = TRUE,
                          searching = TRUE,
                          ordering = TRUE),
            filter = "top",
            rownames = FALSE,
            colnames = c("State", "Year", "Sex", "Name", "Count", "Rate (%)"))
})
```
